## Settlement schedule: blank release checklist

This checklist accompanies a draft settlement agreement. The checklist records matters to be checked before signature; it does not itself release a claim or appoint anyone to act for a party.

1. Identify the dispute being settled. A general reference to “all matters” should not be substituted for the agreed description without instructions about its intended scope.
2. Separate the agreed payment from any proposed future service. A promise to provide a replacement item must identify the item and the delivery condition rather than being treated as an unexplained adjustment to the payment total.
3. Check the schedules against the signed agreement. A missing schedule must be supplied before signature, and a later replacement must remain distinguishable from the version approved by the parties.

The specimen amounts are GBP 600 for repair, GBP 90 for inspection and GBP 40 for delivery. The proposed execution date is 2 February 2027.

Section 7.1, article 18 and schedule 2 apply.

Approval of this checklist does not replace approval of the completed agreement.
